description:
Use this when the user wants to know what clipping a video costs before it runs: "how much will it take to
clip this stream". Returns the Horizon Units (HU) find_clips, find_moments or clip_range would spend. Show the
number, wait for the user's approval, then pass it as max_hu.
Not for: starting the job or pricing an edit (edits cost no HU). Free.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects or a finished import

range_start.description: Start in seconds; 0 and 0 = whole video

name: estimate_hu
title: Quote the clipping cost (Horizon Units)
